text:
Ava (PM): Quick sync — proposing we narrow the observability launch to three concrete deliverables: dashboard templates (cost + latency), tracing-hook standardization, and error-slice analytics. I want to prioritize customer asks by impact vs engineering cost.
Rina: +1. Which customers should drive the initial scope?
Ava (PM): Core list: FintechPilot (cost attribution), DocsSearch (trace flamegraphs for slow reads), RetailAI (error analytics for model fallbacks). Happy to add others if folks have urgent cases.
Diego: For rollout, suggest canary at 5% traffic + automated fallback to sampling policy if latency regressions > 15%. Also call out batching interactions.
Taylor: Cost note — dashboards need sampling-adjusted metrics so customers don't get confused by lower observed token counts. Also ask: include per-route token-cost breakdown (by model variant).
Samira: Draft acceptance criteria to start discussion: 1) Dashboard templates for top 10 most-used routes, 2) Tracing hooks capture 95% of error paths for those routes, 3) Cost delta vs baseline <= 12% on average during canary, 4) Rollback path and documented runbook.
Rina: For tracing hooks we should standardize header propagation (trace-id, span-id, model-route) and make SDK change minimal. Example proto we can aim for: 
```
headers: {
  "x-rd-trace-id": "<uuid>",
  "x-rd-span-id": "<hex>",
  "x-rd-route": "<route-name>"
}
```
Diego: Autoscale + batching question: if we enable continuous batching on the canary path, it may hide some latency regressions. Can we run canary with low-batch config?
Ava (PM): Good catch — canary will use low-batch config. If latency looks good, we toggle a high-batch perf test in staging before full rollout.
ops-bot: deploy-scheduler: tentative deploy window reserved 2024-06-12 02:00 UTC for canary rollout.
Taylor: Customer ask: add a "hot-token spikes" widget (alerts for per-route token spend > X std dev) — helps FintechPilot and RetailAI.
Samira: I'll draft runbook sections: pre-checks, health indicators (latency P95, error-slice counts, per-route cost), rollback steps, and postmortem template.
Rina: I'll open a spec PR with the tracing hook RFC + sample queries for error-slice analytics. Will include tracing sampling config suggestion: 
```
sampling:
  traces: 0.05
  spans_per_trace: 50
  error_bias: 0.9
```
Diego: Owner assignment idea — split into three tracks: dashboards (Taylor), tracing hooks (Rina), error analytics (Samira). Eng-runtime/Eng-platform to review feasibility.
Ava (PM): Assign owners and triage customer asks by EOW. I'll consolidate customer-priority matrix (impact vs cost) and share. Tagging @eng-platform and @eng-runtime for feasibility check.
Taylor: Copy — will start template inventory and list which routes we can include in top-10.
Diego: Next steps: 1) Owners accept by EOD, 2) Rina to PR tracing RFC by Wed, 3) Samira to draft runbook skeleton, 4) Ava to publish customer priority matrix.
Samira: I'll add monitoring alerts and slack escalation steps to the runbook.
Ava (PM): Thanks all — small follow-up meeting tomorrow 10am to lock canary config. :thumbsup:
